  df <- as.data.frame(df, check.names = FALSE); rownames(df) <- NULL
  num <- vapply(df, is.numeric, logical(1))

    if (all(is.na(v) | v == round(v))) as.character(v) else coma(v, d))

```{r funciones, include = FALSE}
estandarizar <- function(M) {
  M <- as.matrix(M); m <- colMeans(M)
  s <- sqrt(colMeans(sweep(M, 2, m)^2)); sweep(sweep(M, 2, m), 2, s, "/")
}
pca_basico <- function(Z) {
  e <- eigen(crossprod(Z) / nrow(Z), symmetric = TRUE); V <- e$vectors
  for (k in seq_len(ncol(V))) if (sum(V[V[, k] < 0, k]^2) > sum(V[V[, k] > 0, k]^2)) V[, k] <- -V[, k]
  list(valores = e$values, vectores = V, scores = Z %*% V)
}
mm_causal <- function(x, w) as.numeric(stats::filter(x, rep(1 / w, w), sides = 1))
particion_fisher <- function(Y, k_max = 10, tam_min = 12) {
  Y <- as.matrix(Y); n <- nrow(Y)
  S1 <- rbind(0, apply(Y, 2, cumsum)); S2 <- c(0, cumsum(rowSums(Y^2)))
  sce <- function(i, j) { s <- S1[j + 1, ] - S1[i + 1, ]; S2[j + 1] - S2[i + 1] - sum(s * s) / (j - i) }
  D <- matrix(Inf, k_max, n); B <- matrix(0L, k_max, n)
  for (j in tam_min:n) D[1, j] <- sce(0, j)
  for (k in 2:k_max) {
    if (k * tam_min > n) break
    for (j in (k * tam_min):n) {
      ini <- ((k - 1) * tam_min):(j - tam_min)
      costos <- vapply(ini, function(i) D[k - 1, i] + sce(i, j), numeric(1))
      D[k, j] <- min(costos); B[k, j] <- ini[which.min(costos)]
    }
  }
  res <- list()
  for (k in 1:k_max) {
    if (!is.finite(D[k, n])) next
    cortes <- integer(0); j <- n
    if (k > 1) for (kk in k:2) { i <- B[kk, j]; cortes <- c(i, cortes); j <- i }
    res[[k]] <- list(sce = D[k, n], cortes = cortes)
  }
  res
}
regla_d12 <- function(sce, umbral = 0.10) {
  r <- (head(sce, -1) - tail(sce, -1)) / head(sce, -1)
  bajo <- which(r < umbral)
  if (length(bajo)) return(min(bajo))
  caida <- c(NA, head(r, -1)) - r
  which.max(caida)
}
tucker <- function(a, b) sum(a * b) / sqrt(sum(a^2) * sum(b^2))
```

# Análisis en componentes principales

```{r pca-calculo}
Z <- estandarizar(X)
R <- crossprod(Z) / n
pc <- pca_basico(Z)
lam <- pc$valores
r_eje <- sweep(pc$vectores, 2, sqrt(lam), "*")
F_scores <- pc$scores
```

## Adecuación de los datos

```{r kmo}
Ri <- solve(R)
P_parcial <- -Ri / sqrt(outer(diag(Ri), diag(Ri))); diag(P_parcial) <- 0
R0 <- R; diag(R0) <- 0
kmo_global <- sum(R0^2) / (sum(R0^2) + sum(P_parcial^2))
kmo_serie <- colSums(R0^2) / (colSums(R0^2) + colSums(P_parcial^2))
chi2 <- -(n - 1 - (2 * p + 5) / 6) * log(det(R)); gl <- p * (p - 1) / 2
data.frame(Medida = c("KMO global", "Bartlett: chi cuadrado", "Bartlett: grados de libertad", "Bartlett: p"),
           Valor = c(coma(kmo_global), coma(chi2, 1), gl, format.pval(pchisq(chi2, gl, lower.tail = FALSE)))) |>
  knitr::kable()
tabla(data.frame(Serie = nombres, KMO = kmo_serie, `Calidad en los ejes 1–3` = rowSums(r_eje[, 1:3]^2),
                 check.names = FALSE), 2)
```

## Valores propios

```{r valores-propios}
set.seed(42)
sims <- t(replicate(1000, eigen(cor(matrix(rnorm(n * p), n)), symmetric = TRUE, only.values = TRUE)$values))
horn95 <- apply(sims, 2, quantile, 0.95)
vara <- sapply(1:p, function(k) 100 * sum(1 / (k:p)) / p)
vp <- data.frame(Eje = 1:p, `Valor propio` = lam, `Inercia (%)` = 100 * lam / p,
                 `Acumulada (%)` = cumsum(100 * lam / p), `Análisis paralelo (p95)` = horn95,
                 `Vara quebrada (%)` = vara, check.names = FALSE)
tabla(vp[1:8, ], 3)
```

## Clases con el corte en 0,7

```{r hfc-clases}
clases_corte <- function(merge, altura, umbral = 0.7) {
  nod <- list()
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(merge))) {
    g <- function(k) if (k < 0) -k else nod[[k]]
    nod[[i]] <- c(g(merge[i, 1]), g(merge[i, 2]))
  }
  clases <- as.list(seq_len(nrow(merge) + 1))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(merge))) if (altura[i] <= umbral) {
    u <- nod[[i]]; clases <- c(Filter(function(cl) !all(cl %in% u), clases), list(u))
  }
  clases
}
cl07 <- clases_corte(h$hier$merge, h$hier$height)
data.frame(Clase = seq_along(cl07), Series = sapply(cl07, function(cl) paste(nombres[sort(cl)], collapse = ", ")),
           `N.º de series` = lengths(cl07), check.names = FALSE) |> knitr::kable()
```

a <- aede_r(serie = as.data.frame(X), nw = 48, nsd = 3, ndim = 3, maxcl = 10)
ev <- a$eigenvalues

C <- a$correlationlsq
horn <- read.csv(file.path(raiz, "data/results/final/R_aede_horn_umbrales.csv"))
w_aede <- exp(-0.5 * (((1:48) - 24.5) / (47 / sqrt(2)) * 3)^2); w_aede <- w_aede / sum(w_aede)
n_ef <- 1 / sum(w_aede^2)
umbral <- sapply(1:3, function(k) approx(horn$n_horn[horn$eje == k], horn$horn_p95[horn$eje == k], n_ef)$y)

## Seguimiento de los ejes entre ventanas

```{r epca-seguimiento}
permutaciones <- list(c(1, 2, 3), c(1, 3, 2), c(2, 1, 3), c(2, 3, 1), c(3, 1, 2), c(3, 2, 1))
Cs <- C; previa <- c(1, 2, 3); cambios <- character(0)
for (t in 2:dim(C)[1]) {
  val <- sapply(permutaciones, function(pm) sum(sapply(1:3, function(k) abs(tucker(C[t, , pm[k]], Cs[t - 1, , k])))))
  pm <- permutaciones[[which.max(val)]]
  if (!identical(pm, previa)) { cambios <- c(cambios, rownames(ev)[t]); previa <- pm }
  Cs[t, , ] <- C[t, , pm]
  for (k in 1:3) if (tucker(Cs[t, , k], Cs[t - 1, , k]) < 0) Cs[t, , k] <- -Cs[t, , k]
}
congr <- t(sapply(2:dim(Cs)[1], function(t) sapply(1:3, function(k) tucker(Cs[t, , k], Cs[t - 1, , k]))))
data.frame(`Ventanas con intercambio de ejes` = paste(cambios, collapse = ", "),
           `Congruencia consecutiva mínima` = coma(min(abs(congr))),
           `Ventanas con congruencia < 0,9` = sum(apply(abs(congr) < 0.9, 1, any)), check.names = FALSE) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

# Clasificación factorial jerárquica evolutiva

```{r claede-calculo}
hfc_ventana <- function(V) {
  Rw <- .bstatw_ac(V, w_aede)$correlations
  j <- agrega_r(Rw)
  merge <- ifelse(j$nab <= p, -j$nab, j$nab - p)
  list(merge = merge, height = j$indice)
}
wn <- n - 48 + 1
jer <- lapply(1:wn, function(t) hfc_ventana(X[t:(t + 47), ]))
cls <- lapply(jer, function(j) clases_corte(j$merge, j$height))
ref <- which(nombres == "Crédito hipotecario")
M_c1 <- t(sapply(cls, function(cl) as.integer(seq_len(p) %in% Filter(function(x) ref %in% x, cl)[[1]])))
n_clases <- lengths(cls)
alturas <- t(sapply(jer, function(j) sort(j$height, decreasing = TRUE)[1:3]))
```

## Dendrogramas en cuatro ventanas

```{r fig-claede-dendrogramas, fig.height = 8}
op <- par(mfrow = c(2, 2), mar = c(7, 4, 2, 1))
for (s in c("2009-07", "2014-07", "2020-07", "2023-07")) {
  j <- jer[[which(rownames(ev) == s)]]
  hc <- structure(list(merge = j$merge, height = j$height, order = {
    hojas <- function(k) if (k < 0) -k else c(hojas(j$merge[k, 1]), hojas(j$merge[k, 2]))
    hojas(nrow(j$merge)) }, labels = nombres, method = "hfc"), class = "hclust")
  plot(hc, hang = -1, main = paste("Ventana", s), sub = "", xlab = "", ylab = "Índice", cex = 0.6)
  abline(h = 0.7, col = "#c0392b", lty = 2)
}
par(op)
```

# Segmentación temporal

```{r segmentacion-calculo}
l1 <- ev[, 1]
part_e <- particion_fisher(matrix(l1), 10, 12)
sce_e <- sapply(part_e, `[[`, "sce")
K_e <- regla_d12(sce_e)
Yp <- sapply(1:3, function(k) mm_causal(F_scores[, k], 12))
ok <- complete.cases(Yp); f_p <- fechas[ok]
Yp <- estandarizar(Yp[ok, ])
part_p <- particion_fisher(Yp, 10, 12)
sce_p <- sapply(part_p, `[[`, "sce")
K_p <- regla_d12(sce_p)
cortes_e <- format(f_ev[part_e[[K_e]]$cortes + 1], "%Y-%m")
cortes_p <- format(f_p[part_p[[K_p]]$cortes + 1], "%Y-%m")
```

tabla(data.frame(K = 1:10, `SCD estructura` = sce_e, `Δ estructura` = red(sce_e),
                 `SCD posición` = sce_p, `Δ posición` = red(sce_p), check.names = FALSE), 3)

# Caracterización de los regímenes

```{r caracterizacion}
interanual <- function(x) c(rep(NA, 12), 100 * (x[13:n] / x[1:(n - 12)] - 1))
cred <- X[, "Crédito empresarial"] + X[, "Crédito consumo"] + X[, "Crédito hipotecario"]
g <- interanual(cred / X[, "IPC Lima"])
m_g <- median(g, na.rm = TRUE); s_g <- sqrt(mean((g - mean(g, na.rm = TRUE))^2, na.rm = TRUE))
fase <- function(mk, c) ifelse(mk > m_g + c * s_g, "expansión", ifelse(mk < m_g - c * s_g, "contracción", "transición"))
perfil <- function(cortes, f0, f1) {
  ini <- match(c(f0, cortes), fechas_txt); fin <- c(ini[-1] - 1, match(f1, fechas_txt))
  do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(ini), function(k) {
    a <- ini[k]; b <- fin[k]; mk <- median(g[a:b], na.rm = TRUE)
    data.frame(`N.º` = k, Período = paste(fechas_txt[a], "a", fechas_txt[b]), Meses = b - a + 1,
               `Crédito real (%)` = mk, `PBI (%)` = mean(interanual(X[, "PBI"])[a:b], na.rm = TRUE),
               `Inflación (%)` = mean(interanual(X[, "IPC Lima"])[a:b], na.rm = TRUE),
               `Tasa inicio` = mean(X[a:(a + 2), "Tasa de referencia"]), `Tasa fin` = mean(X[(b - 2):b, "Tasa de referencia"]),
               `EMBIG (pb)` = mean(X[a:b, "EMBIG Perú"]), `Fase (c = 1)` = fase(mk, 1), `Fase (c = 0,5)` = fase(mk, 0.5),
               check.names = FALSE)
  }))
}
data.frame(Medida = c("Mediana del crecimiento real del crédito (m)", "Desviación estándar (s)"),
           Valor = coma(c(m_g, s_g))) |> knitr::kable()
```

```{r fig-fases}

  geom_hline(yintercept = m_g, colour = GRIS) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = m_g + c(-1, 1) * s_g, colour = NARANJA, linetype = 2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = m_g + c(-0.5, 0.5) * s_g, colour = NARANJA, linetype = 3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = as.Date(paste0(cortes_p, "-01")), colour = "grey60") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Crecimiento interanual real del crédito (%)")
```
